Kikuletwa (Chemka) Hot Springs

II · DAY 2
Tarangire National Park
Famous for elephant herds and ancient baobabs along the river

Momella Lakes
Flamingo-lined lakes with Kilimanjaro and Meru views, a calm closing scenic drive
